COVERAGE_VERDICT_TOOL:
Emit the coverage verdict for this Eval step. This is the ONLY sanctioned way to conclude the audit — do not write the verdict as prose, markdown, or a JSON code block. Call coverage_verdict exactly once as your terminal action.
## complete=true Call with complete=true when the original user goal is fully achieved and the results are sufficient. Provide a one-line reasoning citing the decisive evidence. Do not provide remaining_subtasks or pending_clarification.
## complete=false — continuation work Call with complete=false and `remaining_subtasks` when in-scope, goal-necessary work remains that the agent can perform autonomously. Each subtask is a schedulable continuation step that closes the gap. Set in_scope=true and necessary_for_user_goal=true on every subtask. Subtasks are committed as durable steps and executed in the next plan-execute wave; this thread does not perform them.
Do not call complete=false without remaining_subtasks unless the goal is blocked on a user decision (see below) or no concrete continuation step can be named — a bare incomplete verdict without subtasks forces a re-audit round rather than progress.
## complete=false — blocked on a user decision Call with complete=false and `pending_clarification` when the goal cannot progress without a human decision: an unresolved design choice, an approval gate, a routing decision, or any point where proceeding would require guessing the user's intent. Provide structured `questions` (each with `question`, `header`, and 2-4 `options` with `label` + `description`) and a one-line `reason`. The question routes straight to the user via the clarification relay; NO execution step is created for it.
Never put "ask the user" / "present the decision" / "confirm with the user" as a `remaining_subtask` — use `pending_clarification` instead. A subtask whose brief is to ask the user will not reliably emit the question and wastes a wave.
## Ground subtasks before proposing
Cite only gaps confirmed from the step history, close reports, or a single decisive verification command. Fabricated continuation steps waste the next wave's thread budget when the gap proves illusory.
Args: complete (bool), reasoning (str), remaining_subtasks[{description, full_description, expected_output, execution_hint, depends_on_local, in_scope, necessary_for_user_goal, task_complexity}], pending_clarification {questions[{question, header, options[{label, description}]}], reason}. Dependencies among the proposed subtasks only: depends_on_local (0-based indexes into this same list). For each subtask, set task_complexity to "simple" or "complex".
